three of the ten rows were decided in-tree 21 minutes before draw 7 preregistered the family, and the cause is the DEFINITION, not the test that demonstrates it. Nat.fermatNumber was admitted at 2026-08-30 06:48:10 (0065c83b1); draw 7 preregistered fermat-numbers held-out at 2026-08-30 07:09:52 (29d51bd0b); git merge-base --is-ancestor confirms the order. F:ml430-nat-fermatnumber-{zero,one,two} state fermatNumber 0 = 3, fermatNumber 1 = 5 and fermatNumber 2 = 17 -- CLOSED equations between a constant applied to numerals and a numeral, so each is decided by reduction alone and closes by Eq.refl the moment the Definition exists. The same commit's nat_prelude_tests.rs::fermat_number_evaluates_correctly asserts all three by Kernel::def_eq, which is the running demonstration that the reduction fires -- but it is a witness to the spend, not its cause: removing the test would not have made the rows blind again. ADR-0653's exemption -- 'the evaluation-test requirement for a new Definition is safe here precisely because a test is not a declaration' -- is therefore true and beside the point, and ADR-0695 replaces it. R9 screens the Mathlib source names (Nat.fermatNumber_zero and siblings), which are absent from the environment, so it reported a clean 0 of 10. The family is moved as a whole because partition_unit is whole-family-with-source-review-groups-indivisible; the remaining seven rows (coprimality, monotonicity, oddness, fermat_primeFactors_one_lt, pow_of_pow_add_prime) are genuinely unproved here and stay fully usable in development. policy_amendments.reason: train is the TRAINING partition. Nothing about held-out blindness, or about development being the tuning set, depends on a development row citing a proved train lemma -- that is what a training set is for. The property the split actually protects is (a) held-out isolation, enforced independently by check-autogenesis-holdout-isolation.py, check-holdout-adjacency.py and check-holdout-closed-evaluation.py, and (b) development not being the population a producer is tuned against, enforced independently by check-development-partition.py. Listing train as an evaluation partition made 147 dev<->train depends_on edges leaks that no repair could remove, because depends_on is derived from the admitted proof term (ADR-1551) and is therefore not a free variable. ADR-1563 refused to amend those 147 edges precisely because they contradicted THIS list; the list is what is wrong, so the list is what changes.
does_not_change: no row moves partition, and no held-out row's outcome is named
held-out stays sealed in every direction: development->held-out, train->held-out and held-out->anything all remain crossings
longitudinal->evaluation remains a crossing (ADR-1563's direction argument is untouched)
the 6 held-out-endpoint crossings stay baselined and structurally un-amendable (ADR-1563)

partition_roles.crossing_rule: a declared-dependency edge between a TRAINING partition and a non-blind EVALUATION partition is not a partition crossing, in either direction; every other edge between two distinct partitions is. A blind partition is sealed in both directions -- an edge from or to it is a crossing whatever the other endpoint's role, because blindness once spent cannot be un-spent.
